caseNameFull: Shelley B. Hutchinson v. William M. Sperry and Emily Sperry, his wife, Farmers' Loan & Trust Co. of New York, etc.
attorneys: Mr. William Mayo Atkinson for appellant. Messrs. Frederick Geller, Frederic J. Faulke, Robert H. McCarter, and Josiah Stryker for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of sections 128 and 240 of the Judicial Code; Farrell v. O’Brien, 199 U. S. 89, 100; Goodrich v. Ferris, 214 U. S. 71, 79.
